'''Minder Five''' was a [[Minder (Imperial Intelligence)|Minder]] within [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] who was assigned to review the status of [[Samara Mindak]] and her father [[Theovor Mindak|Theovor]] after an [[Cipher Nine|agent's]] operation involving them.
